tooltip.create-security.obsidian_securit: A _blast proof_ version that can only be broken by/nthe player who _placed_ it/n/n§7Immune to/n _explosions_, the _wither_ and the _ender dragon_/n§7Keycard Readers/n Mount onto it like the vanilla block

screen.create-security.player_list_mode_: Include: the camera only detects players on this list
Exclude: the camera detects everyone EXCEPT players on this list
The Camera can be placed on the side of a block
Additionally, it can also be placed on top or on the bottom of a block
Its lens points in the FACING direction
Clicking on the camera opens its GUI
The two left-hand slots are used to set a frequency
The third slot accepts a Fisheye Lens for a wider field of view
create-security.ponder.camera_display_in: To display the live feed from the camera, start by placing a Camera Display block
Camera Displays can be scaled infinitely if they are placed in a 3:2 ratio
Now, place a Camera Link behind the Camera Display block
Clicking the Camera Link opens its GUI where you can set a frequency
Make sure that the frequency is the same as the camera you want to display if not it won't work
